title: Pre-built common test paper (fixed-tests v1)
description: One ready-made test, identical for every student. Built by tools/prep-fixed-tests.mjs with prep-assess.js assemble() and fixed seeds. Served from R2 prep-bank/v1/tests/<exam>/<format>/<id>.json through /api/prep/bank/. Holds question locators only ([subject, module, item id]); never question text. Immutable once published: a changed paper gets a new id, never new bytes.

exam.description: Exam profile id this paper was assembled for.

title.description: Shown in the Tests tab, e.g. NEET-PG Grand Test 07.

scope.description: Plain-language scope, e.g. All NEET-PG subjects, Part 1, Anatomy.

seed.description: Fixed seed passed to assemble(); rebuilds byte-identical items.

test_type.description: Assembler test type used (image/pyq use custom).

planned.description: Quota per subject the blueprint asked for.

actual.description: Questions per subject the paper holds.

sections.description: Locked timed sections ([id, label, n, sec, from, to]) or null for single-timer papers.

bank.description: Bank versions the items were drawn from, { version: [subjects] }.

items.description: [subject, module, item id] per question, in paper order. PYQ items use [pyq, mix, id].
